t: Ready-for-use fall restraint kit with 45mm wide-strap harness, 2 adjustment loops and 2 adjustable side plates. Features zinc-coated steel karabiner, 17mm opening, screw manual double-locking system, and 12mm diameter removable 1.5m rope lanyard, fitted with 2 blue wear-threads and ribbon to ensure traceability. 2 thimbled loops protect rope against wear caused by connector passage. Supplied in handy storage bag.
